脚本最多为 32 KiB。: Scripts may contain at most 32 KiB.
参数名需为不重复的字母、数字或下划线，参数值需为有效数值。: Parameter names must be unique letters, digits or underscores, and values must be valid numbers.
添加自己的防抖和滤波脚本。按传感器样本处理，状态与参数独立；修改随当前配置保存。: Add your own stabilization and filtering scripts. Each sensor sample is processed with independent state and parameters; changes are saved with the current profile.
不同阶段按管线顺序执行，同阶段按列表顺序执行。最多添加 4 个。: Stages run in pipeline order; filters within a stage run in list order. Add up to four filters.
姿态控制模式只经过原始角速度阶段。: Steering mode uses only the raw angular velocity stage.
此阶段没有自定义滤波器。: No custom filters in this stage.
运行耗时显示上次与峰值，状态来自已应用配置。脚本出错或超过预算时自动旁路，重置状: Times show the last call and peak for the applied profile. Errors or budget overruns bypass the filter; reset its state or apply changes to retry.
载入模板会替换当前代码与参数。脚本通过 process(sample, para: Loading a template replaces the current code and parameters. Return [x, y, z] from process(sample, params), and use this to keep independent state.
角速度单位为 °/s，sample.dt 为秒；host_ns 与 sensor: Angular velocity is in °/s and sample.dt is in seconds; host_ns and sensor_ns retain their original timestamps. The raw stage processes three axes; z is zero in the other stages.
脚本无文件、网络或输入输出设备接口。单次调用限制运算量和执行时间，异常、无效数值: Scripts have no file, network or input/output device API. Each call has operation and time limits; errors, invalid numbers or excessive state bypass the filter.
预览只运行当前滤波器和合成信号，不占用手柄。完成后仍需保存配置才能应用。: The preview runs this filter on synthetic signals without opening a controller. Save the profile afterward to apply it.
配置内容超过 256 KiB，请减少脚本或配置层中的重复内容: Profile exceeds 256 KiB; reduce scripts or repeated content in layers
中心死区过滤回中偏移；0.12 表示摇杆中心 12% 不产生瞄准输出。若仍漂移可: The center deadzone filters resting offsets. A value of 0.12 disables aim within the central 12% of travel. Increase it gradually if drift remains; keep it below the Flick threshold. Aim speed rises continuously beyond the deadzone.
摇杆瞄准中心死区必须小于快推转身阈值: The stick aim center deadzone must be below the Flick threshold
请选择 1–4 个有效且不冲突的手柄输入。: Choose 1–4 valid controller inputs without conflicts.
View + Menu 已用于进入手柄界面操作，请选择其他组合。: View + Menu opens controller navigation. Choose a different chord.
手柄单键或最多 4 键组合，与键盘快捷键共用上方目标配置。按一次切换，再按一次返: Use one controller input or a chord of up to four. It shares the target profile above with the keyboard shortcut. Press once to switch and again to return; holding switches only once.
请先松开已有按键，再按住所需组合并全部松开。: Release any held controls, then hold the desired chord and release all controls.
录入期间暂停游戏输出，手柄保持连接；Esc 取消。录入完成后点击保存。: Game output pauses while recording and the controller stays connected. Esc cancels. Save after recording.
请先在上方选择目标配置，保存的手柄快捷键才会生效。: Select a target profile above to enable the saved controller shortcut.
使用当前选中的实体手柄，在映射或观察运行时生效。不会消耗原有映射，建议使用空闲组: Uses the selected physical controller while mapping or observing. Existing mappings still receive these inputs, so choose an unused chord. View + Menu is reserved for controller navigation.
手柄快捷键需要 1–4 个有效且不冲突的输入: Controller shortcuts require 1–4 valid inputs without conflicts
手柄快捷键请选择按键、扳机或摇杆方向，不支持摇杆环区或原始轴: Choose buttons, triggers or stick directions for the controller shortcut; stick rings and raw axes are unsupported
View + Menu 已用于进入手柄界面操作，请选择其他组合: View + Menu opens controller navigation; choose a different chord
正在录入，请按单键或 Ctrl／Alt／Shift 组合键。Esc 取消；录入期: Recording: press a key or a Ctrl/Alt/Shift chord. Esc cancels; game output and automatic switching pause during recording.
